preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 3 and 300.
The number of columns m must be between 3 and 300.
The desired time t must be between 1 and 10^9.
The time for flat ground tp must be between 1 and 100.
The time for ascent tu must be between 1 and 100.
The time for descent td must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= h <= 10**6 for row in heights for h in row)
preconditions.description: All height values must be positive integers not exceeding 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the coordinates of the upper left and lower right corners of the selected rectangle.

postconditions.expression: abs(ts - t) <= min(abs(ts - t) for r1, c1, r2, c2 in rectangles)
postconditions.description: The time difference between the selected track and the desired time t must be minimized.
